title: One very long page
description: A document of 400 sections, far taller than any page. It is one surface: nothing is cut, nothing repeats, and the height is exactly the content.

title: Viewport units
description: vh and vw resolve against the viewport the host reports, not the content: the hero is as tall as the widget, the panel is half of it.

title: Sticky headers
description: A sticky page header and a sticky table header. They follow the top of the viewport as it scrolls and are held inside their containing blocks.

title: Fixed toolbar and badge
description: A fixed bar along the top and a badge in the bottom-right corner stay where they are in the viewport while the page scrolls.

title: Fixed background
description: background-attachment: fixed positions the image against the viewport, so the panels move over a picture that stays where it is.

title: Responsive media queries
description: @media (min-width), (max-width), (orientation) and (min-height) follow the size of the widget: change its width or height in the demo.

title: Light and dark
description: prefers-color-scheme follows the theme the host reports: switch the theme in the demo and the document restyles itself.

title: Hover, press and cursors
description: The interaction styles of a document shown to a pointer: :hover, :active, cursor, pointer-events, inert, user-select and touch-action.

title: Pointer media features
description: hover, any-hover, pointer and any-pointer report the pointing devices the host has: a mouse, a pen, touch, or none.

title: In-page links
description: Links to places in the same document scroll the host so the target is in view; scroll-margin keeps it clear of the bar.

title: Form controls
description: Text fields, a text area, check boxes, radios, a range, a select and buttons, drawn from their own CSS and editable in the widget.

title: Selection and ::selection
description: Select text with the pointer or the keyboard and copy it; the highlight uses the document's ::selection rule or the colour the host sets.

title: Columns on a long page
description: A multi-column container still breaks into columns on screen, including break-before: column, even though there are no pages.

title: Chat messages
description: A column of message bubbles of different heights: the shape of content a chat app puts in a virtualized list, one HtmlView per row.

title: Keyframe animations
description: @keyframes playing over time: rotate, translate, scale and opacity on the GPU, delay, direction, fill-mode and a hover that pauses.

title: Transitions
description: Hover or tab to a card: transform, opacity and filter transitions with easing, steps and delays, plus colour and shadow transitions that repaint only the card.

title: Many animations at once
description: 120 independently animating boxes, each its own retained layer.

title: Animating layout
description: width, height, margin, padding, font-size and flex-grow animate by laying the page out again each frame.

title: Scroll-driven animations
description: A progress bar on scroll(), and cards and swatches on view() with named ranges: progress follows the scroll position, not time.

title: Animated images
description: An animated GIF playing at its own frame durations, also inside a rotating layer.

title: Animated SVG
description: SMIL (animate, set, animateTransform, animateMotion) and CSS animations on the elements of an inline svg: only the svg's rectangle repaints each frame.

title: Scroll containers
description: Elements with overflow: auto clip and scroll by the wheel, chain to the box around them, and drive scroll and view timelines of their own.
